_mo_ta: BANG CHUNG GOC -- hop dong PHAN HOI khi GHI (PATCH/POST/DELETE) do TRUC TIEP tren thiet bi that 192.168.1.1.
_cach_do: Dieu khien Chrome, goi fetch that voi Bearer token that. Moi phep do deu: doc gia tri goc -> ghi -> doc lai xac nhan da doi -> ghi tra ve nhu cu -> doc lai xac nhan da hoan tac. Anh Huynn dong y cho cham nhe co hoan tac.
_pham_vi: 4 resource dai dien: object (upnp), mang co id (portForwarding/policies, staticRouting/policies), va cap doc-ghi khac nhau (system/info doc, system ghi).

1_PATCH_tra_than_RONG.quan_sat: PATCH luon tra HTTP 200, Content-Type application/json, than dai 0 byte.
1_PATCH_tra_than_RONG.he_qua: Gia lap KHONG duoc tra ve doi tuong da cap nhat. Phai tra 200 + than rong. Truoc do config_store.ghi() tra ve du lieu moi -- SAI hop dong.

2_POST_tra_danh_sach_id.quan_sat: POST tra HTTP 200 kem than {"ids": ["<id moi>"]}
2_POST_tra_danh_sach_id.he_qua: Gia lap phai tra dung dang nay, khong tra ca ban ghi vua tao.

3_DELETE_tra_than_RONG.quan_sat: DELETE tra HTTP 200, than 0 byte. Than GUI DI la {"ids": [...]} chu khong phai mang doi tuong.

4_id_do_THIET_BI_sinh.quan_sat: Client POST khong kem id; THIET BI tu sinh. Dinh dang KHAC NHAU tung resource:
4_id_do_THIET_BI_sinh.he_qua: Gia lap phai sinh id dung dinh dang cua TUNG resource (bang DINH_DANG_ID trong config_store.py). Ban nhap tam cua GD2 dung 'sim-1' cho moi thu -- da bo. Resource chua do thi dung mau chung va ghi ro o ISSUES.

5_thiet_bi_tu_dien_truong_thieu.quan_sat: Client POST chi gui source.portRange va destination.{portRange,ipAddress}. Thiet bi tu them source.interfaceId='wan' va destination.interfaceId='lan'.
5_thiet_bi_tu_dien_truong_thieu.he_qua: Gia lap phai bo sung hai truong nay khi tao moi, neu khong trang Edit se thieu du lieu.

6_doc_va_ghi_o_HAI_resource_khac_nhau.quan_sat: GET api/v1/data/system/info tra 10 khoa. PATCH phai gui vao api/v1/data/system (khong phai system/info) thi hostname moi doi. GET api/v1/data/system tra HTTP 0 (dong ket noi, khong tra gi).
6_doc_va_ghi_o_HAI_resource_khac_nhau.he_qua: Xac nhan GHI_CHUYEN_HUONG {'system': 'system/info'} la dung. Khop voi phat hien GD1 ve 4 endpoint 'HTTP 0'.

buoc.nhan: A4 PATCH tra ve nhu cu

phep_do.nhom: B -- resource dang MANG co id (portForwarding/policies)

buoc._chu_y: interfaceId 'wan'/'lan' do THIET BI tu them, client khong gui

phep_do.nhom: C -- doc va ghi o HAI resource khac nhau (system/info vs system)

buoc._chu_y: HTTP 0 = thiet bi dong ket noi khong tra gi. Khop phat hien GD1 ve 4 endpoint chi-ghi.

_con_thieu: Cac resource dang mang khac (dhcp/reservedHosts, staticRouting/policies, publicLan/*) chua do truc tiep. Suy tu B la HOP LY vi cung khuon REST va cung 4 method, nhung CHUA co bang chung rieng -- neu sau nay thay lech thi day la cho can do lai.
ssids / radios / easyMesh: chua do vi ghi that se lam Wi-Fi khoi dong lai, gay mat ket noi. Da co bang chung than GUI DI tu luong dang nhap GD1, chua co bang chung than NHAN VE.

bang_chup_bang_co_dong._vi_sao: Tren thiet bi that ca hai bang deu RONG nen ban chup GD1 khong co markup cua dong. Da tao mot dong thu, chup, roi XOA -- anh Huynn dong y truoc.
